summary:
plan.md is written; I checked block names with `mcd blocks --check` but rendered and built nothing. It's two identical 3-storey brick barracks under 45° red granite hipped roofs (peak at y 13) with 4 dormers each. Each has a full-length white two-storey porch facing south, with diorite-wall posts, a gallery and white trim, and a central slab ramp; the museum also gets red DISNEY/MUSEUM banners and a dark glass pavilion behind.
The white-stucco Officers' Club has red-tile roofs at three heights, a front cross gable with a round window, a white arcade, deep-set windows behind iron bars, cannons and a courtyard. The 1½-storey brick Visitor Center has a hipped roof, dormer, white-post porch, a red PRESIDIO sign band and a flagpole.
Two changes from the brief: the y 13 height cap keeps the brick chimneys below the roof ridge, so they rise from the back slope, and the raised-basement windows are dropped in favour of a stone base course. Four modules square to the grid, south fronts: red-brick three-storey barracks (museum and Montgomery St.) with granite-red hips, brick dormers, white two-storey porches and red banners; the white-stucco Officers' Club with cross-gables, oculus, arcades and cannons; the brick Visitor Center with a red sign and flagpole.
Six parts: shells, club, roofs, porches, fittings and signs, grounds and light. elements.md and plan.md sections are written; every block id is checked against 1.21.1.

parts.name: Brick shells and pavilion
parts.scope: groundCourse for plots 0, 1 and 3. Museum x0..23 z7..14, barracks x24..49 z6..13 with wings x24..30 and x43..49 z0..5, Visitor Center x79..92 z1..6. Use brickBlock (andesite water table y1, brick bands y4 and y7), cornice (white upside-down quartz stairs, y9) and pavilion (x2..21 z1..6). Leave every opening and reserved cell air.

parts.name: Officers' Club shell
parts.scope: Plot 2: stuccoWall for the range x51..75 z9..17 (front 2 thick), the gable block x59..67 z16..21, wings x51..57 and x69..75 z1..8, arcade piers and arches (arcadeBay) z20, courtyard paving and back wall z1 with the arched gate, and the oculus ring. Openings left air.

parts.name: Roofs, dormers, chimneys
parts.scope: roof.json and roof calls for all roofs in the ROOFS table (polished granite red tile, overhang 0 on the barracks), keeping the dormer and stack boxes clear. Then dormer() ×8 and stack() ×4, the club arcade lean-tos (leanTo), and the VC porch roof.

parts.name: Porches, ramps, banners
parts.scope: porchBay along the museum (z15..17, posts x1,5,9,14,18,22) and barracks (z14..16, posts x25,30,34,39,43,48), VC porch posts and deck (z7..8, x80..91), ramp and handrail at the architect's cells, bannerRun DISNEY and MUSEUM, red_wool panels.

parts.name: Glazing, doors, signs, cannons, flag
parts.scope: sashWindow in every window cell of the OPENINGS table, grilleWindow on the club, doubleDoor on the three brick buildings, the club archDoor, VC red sign (red_concrete band, PRESIDIO banners, VISITOR CENTER signboard), cannon x59 and x67, flagpole x93.

parts.name: Grounds and light
parts.scope: Museum shrubs and lawn edge (x0..8 and 15..23, z18..19), courtyard tree x62..64 z4..6, hangLantern under every porch bay (y3 and y6) and each arcade bay, lanterns by doors, and interior lanterns so no cell is dark.

recruit.why: Courses, water table, bands and openings left clean for the barracks and Visitor Center.
Thick white adobe walls, arcade piers and arches, the courtyard.
Steep red hips, cross gables, dormers and lean-tos at several heights.
Brick stacks that rise solid through the roof.
White two-storey porches, ramps and railings.
Red museum banners and the Visitor Center sign.
Lanterns under porches and arcades so no mob spawns.
